pages.title: Small Cauldron
pages.text: The Small Cauldron is used to brew magical mixtures by combining water, ingredients, and heat. Through careful preparation and timing, it produces a wide range of useful concoctions.

pages.title: Brewing Process
pages.text: Fill the cauldron with water from a suitable container, light the cauldron, and add the recipe ingredients one at a time. Use a $(l:hexalia:content/tools#ladle)Ladle$(/l) in your main hand to stir and begin cooking.

pages.title: On Cooking
pages.text: Keep the cauldron lit while it cooks. When the mixture is ready, use a Rustic Bottle to draw out each serving. An empty hand removes loose ingredients before brewing begins.

pages.title: Spoiled Mixture
pages.text: Improper combinations result in a spoiled mixture. This unstable substance emits corrupted energy and can harm those nearby until it is cleansed or removed.

pages.title: Overcooking
pages.text: Leaving a finished brew unattended will degrade its quality, reducing the yield. Careful timing ensures the best results.

pages.title: Ladle
pages.text: A Ladle only stirs a prepared cauldron: it must contain water, be heated, and hold at least one ingredient. Without that setup, mixtures will not properly combine or progress.

pages.title: On Brewing
pages.text: Brewing rewards attention and experimentation. Different ingredient combinations yield different results, with success depending on both preparation and timing.
